scope: Keep keyboard focus inside the selected dock panel when Tab navigation enters the desktop tabbed panel group, despite the right panel appearing after the canvas in DOM order.

behavior.tab_from_active_dock_tab: Focus enters the first visible, enabled control in the selected non-inert panel, rather than following unrelated canvas/header DOM order.
behavior.shift_tab_from_first_panel_control: Focus returns to that selected panel tab; navigation from later controls remains native.
behavior.inactive_panel: Remains inert and excluded from keyboard navigation.
behavior.canvas: The existing 400 CSS px minimum and non-overlapping workspace grid remain unchanged.
